answer:
| Feature | Physisorption (Physical Adsorption) | Chemisorption (Chemical Adsorption) |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Nature of Forces** | Weak van der Waals forces | Strong chemical bonds |
| **Heat of Adsorption** | Low ($20 - 40\text{ kJ mol}^{-1}$) | High ($80 - 400\text{ kJ mol}^{-1}$) |
| **Reversibility** | Reversible | Irreversible |
| **Temperature Dependence** | Decreases with increase in temperature | Increases initially, then decreases |
| **Specificity** | Non-specific | Highly specific |
proTip: Focus on the heat of adsorption and reversibility as they are the most frequently asked differentiating points.
